basics.name: Christopher Cook
basics.summary: Physics PhD student at the University of Texas at Austin. Research in theoretical cosmology and high-energy astrophysics, with a focus on dark energy and gamma-ray bursts.

work.summary: Research on late-time dark energy dynamics and cosmological distances with Prof. Cyr-Racine.
